newsitem.title: USA: Roberds sees Q1 profit, yr EPS $1.20-$1.35.
newsitem.headline: Roberds sees Q1 profit, yr EPS $1.20-$1.35.

text.p: Roberds Inc said Friday it expects the first quarter to be profitable and sees full-year earnings of $1.20 to $1.35 per share.

"We expect the first quarter of 1997 to be profitable, with continuing improvement for the balance of 1997, as some of the programs we put in place in the latter part of 1996 begin to show positive results," said Kenneth Fletcher, chairman, president and chief executive.
"We expect the environment to improve as we move through 1997 and we anticipate earnings of $1.20 to $1.35 per share for 1997," he said.
In the first quarter of 1996, Roberds reported a loss of $0.03 per share, due to severe winter weather and a slowdown in consumer spending.
The company posted a loss of $0.15 per share for the 1996 year, and $1.36 a share in 1995.
Roberds is a retailer of name brand home furnishings products, including furniture, bedding, major appliances and consumer electronics.
